name: MH02a1: New Depression and/or Anxiety
description:
Number of active ART clients newly identified with depression and/or anxiety during the reporting quarter.
The patient's mental-health status must indicate signs and symptoms with low/moderate suicide risk or high suicide risk. These represent symptomatic/new presentations rather than known mental illness states.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.anxiety_and_or_depression IN (
      'Has signs and symptoms with Low/moderate suicide Risk',
      'Has signs and symptoms with high suicide Risk on Medication only',
      'Has signs and symptoms with high suicide Risk on Psychotherapy and Medication'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
